newsitem.title: CANADA: StatsCan survey sees Dec unemployment at 9.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: StatsCan survey sees Dec unemployment at 9.9 pct.

text.p: A Statistics Canada survey of analysts forecast Canadian unemployment to drop slightly to 9.9 percent in December from 10.0 percent in November.
The survey also forecast that consumer prices would rise in December by 2.0 pct from a year earlier.
The survey forecast gross domestic product to rise 0.2 percent in November from October.
The economists also forecast merchandise exports for November at C$22.5 billion, and imports of C$20.1 billion.
The agency on average surveys 17 economists each month.
